files.README.md:
# pg-333: --spacer does not drive --spacer-1 to --spacer-12

Spacing: --spacer-1 to --spacer-12 are computed from $spacer when Sass compiles, so overriding --spacer at runtime moves only the components that read it directly.

Bootstrap main at 2f63a73 (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/commit/2f63a737635d9c8daea42bb5509f4fe81c0e6789), compiled from its source with this reproduction's config: `main.scss` (Sass options), `_custom.scss` (Sass rules) and `tokens.css` (CSS custom properties and rules).

```sh
npm install
npm run dev
```

Exported from https://github.com/julien-deramond/bootstrap-test-playground/tree/main/issues/pg-333
